content:
Updates a scanner group. You cannot use this endpoint to:
Assign a scanner group to a network object. Instead, use the POST
/networks/{network_id}/scanners/{scanner_uuid} endpoint.
Update scan routes configured for the scanner group. Instead, use the PUT /scanner-
groups/group_id/routes endpoint.
Requires the Scan Manager [40] user role. See Roles.
AUTHORIZATIONS:
cloud
PATH PARAMETERS
Content type
integer <int32>
The ID of the scanner group.
REQUEST BODY SCHEMA:
application/json
string
The new name for the scanner group.
